blurb: Guests board a 70-foot catamaran at Heeia Kea Boat Harbor and cruise to the Kaneohe Sandbar in Kaneohe Bay. Activities include snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, banana boat rides, bumper tubes, and relaxing on the sandbar. Tours feature live Hawaiian music and provide a light lunch on the standard tour and additional activities on the all-inclusive tour.

quotes.author: JP
quotes.text: Awesome Activity Just got back this week and this was by far our families favorite thing we did on Oahu. Beautiful crystal clear waters and an amazing backdrop of the Koʻolau Range. The crew was friendly and very organized. The live band on board was an extra plus. They performed a great set and sang so beautifully. This is a 10/10 recommended if you are ever on Oahu.

Such a beautiful place. Crew was great and helpful. Live music on board was soothing and relaxing. Having lunch on board made things easy. Only advice is check the moon calendar. We went during a full moon phase and so the tide was higher than usual in the afternoon but we were all safe and well taken care of.

The whole family enjoyed hanging out at the sandbar. Transportation was easy and the crew was great! Live music and snacks were a hit. The tubing and banana were a favorite for the morning as well. We were able to see a lot of fish while snorkeling too.

My family visiting from Sydney, Australia booked the all-inclusive tour for a fun day out and it didn't disappoint. Great lunch, music was fantastic, and the activities at the sandbar were so much fun! Will recommend to others!

I have been wanting to do this for a very long time we had family friends coming to visit and decided to do this activity. And we absolutely loved it! We had such an amazing fun time. The band was great the crew was amazing

We had an absolutely awesome time on our adventure. The staff was amazing and friendly. The music was fantastic. The water and the sand and the sun were magical. Thank you for such a wonderful experience of a lifetime.
